name: Apprenticeship Maryland at HCPSS
note: Re-verified against the school system's own apprenticeship page on 2026-09-08. The March 1 application deadline is stated without a year, so it is recorded as a stated but undated requirement rather than a 2027 date.

offerings.summary: Howard County seniors work at least 450 hours for a participating employer, about twenty hours a week, while taking a year of related classroom instruction and drawing a paycheck.

loc.venue: Participating employer worksites across Howard County

grades.raw: seniors that are interested in beginning their career pathway while still in high school

school.raw: HCPSS students applying through the course registration process

work_auth.raw: all students must submit a completed work permit

other: completed application form and all required documentation by March 1st
motivated, hardworking students who are eager to learn and are committed to their personal and professional growth
No prior work experience is necessary

items.raw: Earn a paycheck from the start

sched.dur_raw: At least 450 hours (that's about 20+ hours a week) of hands-on experience

app.instructions: Complete the application form during the course registration process; a completed Maryland work permit is also required.

deadlines.raw: Students must complete the application form and provide all required documentation by March 1st.

issues: The page gives March 1st with no year, so this is a stated requirement rather than a dated 2027 deadline.
Paid, but no rate is published.
